replication_status: exact (authors' code reproduces the shipped log, whose 6 post bins equal printed Table 5 column (2) q+1..q+6 = 0.039, 0.055, 0.062, 0.058, 0.061, 0.049 (t = 1.714, 2.782, 1.927, 2.667, 2.500, 1.792) to the printed decimals; published_coef 0.054 is their equal-weight average (log average 0.0541695); N 1,476; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
replication_vs_log: exact (fixest = authors' reghdfe keepsing log to all printed digits; N and clusters match)
notes: Fund flow (winsorized 0.5/99.5). Authors' code (4. table 3 4/Tables 3 and 4.do, line 34): reghdfe quarterlyflow_w05 t_plus1 ... t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps); additionally restricted to e(sample) of the authors' preceding regression with quarterlyret, fullscore_alt and logfundsize (a non-missing restriction only, flag s_t3). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef 0.05416949 vs 0.0541695, N 1476 vs 1476, clusters 156 vs 156. Regression sample: N = 1476, 156 funds, 41 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 30, of which 27 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 40 of the 41 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 34 (7.0% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 10. Event study: the authors' dynamic columns use post-only bins t_plus1..t_plus6 (= row-count j = 0..5) with all pre-signing rows pooled as the reference. run_spec.R with event_pre_min = 0 and event_post_max = 5 reproduces this structure (pre rows -> reference -1) but bins by CALENDAR relative time; 20 treated rows fall in a different bin and 13 rows with calendar relative time > 5 go to the separate endpoint bin (excluded from the post average). Authors' post average (equal weight over the 6 bins) = 0.0541695; calendar-bin TWFE post average on the same sample = 0.0554114 (raw units). A fully dynamic specification with leads is not used because, without never-treated funds, unit FE + period FE + all relative-time dummies are collinear. Table/column labels are inferred from package folder names and code order (no article text). Outcome winsorized at 0.5/99.5 on the full 105,571-row file before the opentonewinv filter (winsor2 emulated with Stata's _pctile rule = R quantile type 2; the coefficient matches the log to 7 digits). run_spec.R also maps funds that signed before the first sample period to period 1, which shifts their relative-time bins (TVL spec: 35 funds, 113 rows).

event_structure.source: 4. table 3 4/Tables 3 and 4.do line 34: reghdfe quarterlyflow_w05 t_plus1-t_plus6 if j>-8 & j<6, a(wficn1 yearqtr) cluster(wficn1) keepsing. t_plusk = 1[j == k-1] (verified), where j is the authors' ROW-COUNT event quarter (1. building data/3_2.x-section.sas lines 316-350: j = 0 at the fund's first post-signing row, +-1 per panel row); all pre-signing rows (j = -7..-1) are the pooled reference and the j window is the sample filter. Pipeline rel = q - gpost (gpost = q at j == 0 for every fund; true pre-sample signing quarters are in gvar). rel = j except after a gap in the fund's quarterly panel (then rel > j). The last bin is open ([5,null]) so that treated rows with j <= 5 but rel > 5 stay in a post bin and the authors' N is kept.
event_structure.verified: TWFE with these bins on j (event_time_authors_var) reproduces the 6 logged coefficients, max abs diff 4.1e-08, N 1476. Calendar bins (rel = t - g, true gpost; used by CSA cells) differ: 13 of 733 treated rows fall in a different bin; TWFE with calendar bins would give max abs coefficient diff 4.3e-03 and post average 0.0556167 vs logged 0.0541695 (raw units).

event_time_authors_note: Lead decision (Nov 2): TWFE indicators and the imputation estimator's observation-level bin averages use the bins and ref of event_structure on the authors' row-count event quarter j (column j of the data file; no NA in the sample); DiD-averaging (CSA) cells are calendar (g,t) cells and use rel = t - g with the same bin boundaries. uncovered = ref (no drop).
presample_adopters_nov2: 17 funds (48 rows) signed before the first sample period; their true signing period is in gvar, so no adoption_var is needed.
